title: Hand Pollinating Irises, From Technique to Planting Seeds.
description:
I enjoy the whole process of growing Irises, Being able to produce a new variety of Iris appealed to me, so I learned how to hand pollinate them. I quickly discovered that it wasn't hard at all. I hope you decide to give it a try if you already grow them. It really is as easy as this video makes it look.

American Iris Society: http://www.irises.org
